title: The 5 Best Pet Cameras for Apartments
h1: The 5 Best Pet Cameras for Apartments
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for pet cameras for apartments, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at pet cameras for apartments using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: TP-Link Tapo C210
products.blurb: Key specs: 2K resolution, 360° pan / 114° tilt, Compact tabletop or wall-optional design, MicroSD storage up to 512GB.
strengths: Small footprint sits easily on a shelf, console table, or windowsill without any drilling
360° pan covers a full studio or one-bedroom layout from a single central spot
Local microSD storage skips a mandatory subscription for a space you may not stay in long-term
limitations: 114° tilt range doesn't reach a second story or loft area as well as a taller mount
Fewer smart home integrations than Ring for households on Alexa routines
features: Works with Alexa and Google Assistant

products.name: Ring Indoor Cam (2nd Gen)
products.blurb: Key specs: 1080p HD video with color night vision, 115° horizontal field of view, Compact plug-in design with swivel mount.
strengths: Compact plug-in body tucks into an outlet-adjacent spot without cables trailing across a small room
Works well as a dual-purpose pet and apartment security camera
No-drill swivel mount option if a tabletop spot isn't available
limitations: 115° fixed field of view may not reach every corner of an irregularly shaped apartment
Ring Protect subscription needed to save and review clips
No pet-specific detection, alerts fire for hallway noise through thin apartment walls too
features: 1080p HD video with color night vision
Compact plug-in design with swivel mount

products.name: Wyze Cam Pan v3
products.blurb: Key specs: 360° pan / 180° tilt coverage, 1080p color night vision, Pan Scan auto-patrol with 4 waypoints.
strengths: Full 180° tilt reaches higher shelves and lofted sleeping areas better than fixed-tilt alternatives
Pan Scan auto-patrol is useful for checking a two-room apartment layout from one central unit
Lowest price of the pan/tilt cameras in this list
No subscription required for basic live view and alerts
limitations: Motion tracking follows only one moving subject at a time
Two-way audio is thinner than the Petcube's 4-microphone array
features: No subscription required for live view

products.name: Petcube Bites 2
products.blurb: Key specs: 1080p HD video with 160° full-room view, Built-in treat dispenser with adjustable toss distance, 4-microphone array with 2-way audio.
strengths: 160° fixed view covers most of a studio apartment without needing to pan
Treat dispenser is a genuine added value in a small space where a pet spends most of its day
4-microphone array works well in the tighter acoustics of a smaller apartment
limitations: Fixed lens with no pan/tilt, unlike the other three options here
features: Built-in treat dispenser with adjustable toss distance

products.name: WYZE Cam v4 2.5K Indoor/Outdoor Camera
limitations: Advanced AI alerts need a plan

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
